summary: Google DeepMind introduced a sign-language-to-text (SL2T) translation model that powers new ASL-to-English sign-to-text dictation features in Gboard and Live Transcribe, launching first on Pixel 11.

practices.reason: SL2T is a specialized, product-embedded model whose visual pose-based translation and hallucination-mitigation gains are not something a general engineering team could adopt via API.
practices.quote: SL2T achieves a remarkable zero-shot score of 70 BLEURT, which is significantly higher than any previously reported score.

practices.reason: The FLEURS-ASL benchmark and BLEURT scoring are a domain-specific evaluation methodology, informative but not directly transferable to general LLM evaluation pipelines.
practices.quote: SL2T is the most capable sign language translation model to date according to key benchmarks like FLEURS-ASL (sd-test), which assesses ASL to English translation quality.
